fields.label: Description
fields.description: e.g. Cotton Poplin 120 GSM, 11 Lines Plastic Button

fields.label: Consumption
fields.description: Shown as-is on the Tech Pack, e.g. '1.65 m' or '7 Nos'

fields.label: Available in Market
fields.description: Uncheck if this material is not available in market

fields.label: Line ID
fields.description: Stable identifier generated on insert. Used to join Style BOM Override rows to this line. Never recomputed - do not edit.

fields.label: Varies by Colour
fields.description: Item code changes per colourway (e.g. body fabric, thread). Invariant lines (labels, packing) leave unchecked.

fields.label: Varies by Size
fields.description: Quantity (or item code) changes per size (e.g. fabric consumption, elastic length).

fields.label: Resolution Rule
fields.options:
Fixed
Match garment colour
Explicit Override
fields.description: Fixed: always use Selected Item. Match garment colour: auto-resolve to the Colour-attribute variant of Selected Item unless an override says otherwise. Explicit Override: only a Style BOM Override row can change this line - no auto-matching.
